content: To finish with this experiment set, Table also shows the strict classification precision, recall and F1-score for the compared systems. Despite the fact that, in general, the systems obtain high values, BERT outperforms them again. BERT's F1-score is 1.9 points higher than the next most competitive result in the comparison. More remarkably, the recall obtained by BERT is about 5 points above.
